summary: All three agents—Maria (Primary Decision Maker), the child (Affected Third Party), and the External Advisor—independently reached full convergence on a novel action that goes beyond the original binary options: Maria should not implement her own discipline methods unilaterally (rejecting ACTION_1), but neither should the matter simply be dropped (avoiding a passive ACTION_2).
